name: survicate
description: Analyze the survey feedback collected in your Survicate workspace: ask questions across responses, pull NPS, CSAT and rating results with verbatim answers, read research reports, and draft surveys.

interface.longDescription:
Survicate is a customer feedback and survey platform. This plugin lets you analyze the survey responses collected in your Survicate workspace from ChatGPT. Ask what customers said about a topic and get an answer grounded in real survey responses, with citations. Pull NPS, CSAT and rating scores, read what detractors or promoters wrote, and browse the research projects, reports, insights and notes your team already has in Survicate Research Hub.

You can also create a new survey as a draft for a teammate to review, organize surveys into folders, start or stop a survey when you ask for it, fill a survey with sample responses for a demo, save a research note, start a research project, or archive surveys you no longer need.

Every request runs as you, with the Survicate permissions you already have. The plugin reads and writes only the surveys, results and research material you can see in Survicate. It never deletes surveys, responses or notes, never exports files, and never changes workspace or billing settings.

A Survicate account with the User role or higher is required. You sign in to Survicate once when you add the plugin; there are no API keys.
capabilities: Read survey results and verbatim answers
Browse research projects, reports and insights
defaultPrompt: List my surveys and tell me which one got the most responses this month.
What is our NPS, and what did detractors write?
What research do we already have on onboarding?

positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected workspace and links to it in the Survicate panel.

positive.prompt: List my surveys and tell me which one got the most responses.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the surveys of the test workspace with their status and response counts, and names the one with the most responses.

positive.description: Read the NPS score of a given survey
positive.prompt: Based on this survey, what's our NPS score? bc030a194d69fe41
positive.expected_behavior: Opens survey bc030a194d69fe41 in the test workspace, finds its NPS question, and reports the NPS score with the number of answers and the split of promoters, passives and detractors.

positive.prompt: Can you tell me what we've learned from Onboarding Navigation Issues research project?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the "Onboarding Navigation Issues" research project in the test workspace and summarizes its report with its citations.

positive.description: Draft a survey without launching it
positive.prompt: Create me survey that I can run in product, that will ask users why they canceled subscription
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft in-product (web) survey in the test workspace asking why users canceled their subscription, returns the review link, and states that the survey is not live until someone launches it in Survicate.

negative.prompt: Email this survey to all our customers right now.
Delete the onboarding survey and all of its responses.
Export all responses of the NPS survey to a CSV file.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: survey results, feedback questions, Research Hub reports and notes, survey drafting and folders.
